_comment: Reference config for the FOUR Railway Cron services that drive Niftea.
Railway cron services run a one-shot command on a schedule, then the
container sleeps until the next tick — you only pay for run time, and
nothing has to stay on at your end.
Railway does NOT support multiple services from one railway.json, so create
each cron as its own service in the Railway dashboard (New > Empty Service,
same repo) and paste the matching values below. See DEPLOYMENT.md > Scheduling.
Schedules are in UTC. IST = UTC+5:30. NSE trades 09:15-15:30 IST (Mon-Fri).

cron-daily-brief._when: 08:00 IST (pre-market) Mon-Fri — generates & publishes the daily brief

cron-sector-morning._when: 09:30 IST Mon-Fri — sector pulse opening snapshot

cron-sector-midsession._when: 12:30 IST Mon-Fri — sector pulse mid-session snapshot

cron-sector-closing._when: 15:45 IST Mon-Fri — sector pulse closing snapshot
